purpose: The machine-readable, normative canonical AST contract. C, Swift, Kotlin, and TypeScript declare projections of this shape, and scripts/audit-ast-projections.mjs checks every projection plus the prose and debug-dump tables against this file. Formula is the only kind whose placement mode varies; placement for Code, CodeBlock, Directive, DirectiveBlock, and FormulaBlock is implied by the kind.

walk.order: Depth first. A node enters, then its owned Markup-valued fields are visited in canonical field order with arrays retaining stored order, then the node exits. Relations remain named fields; the walk does not project them into generic children.

kinds.name: Document
kinds.invariants: block content; `footnotes` is the document-owned sequence of every winning or unreferenced footnote definition, ordered by scope start, visited after `content`, and never counted among its children

kinds.name: Callout
kinds.invariants: every `>` container; `variant` is the authored type as written or null when the container has no metadata line, and then `collapsed` and `title` are null; `collapsed` is null when no `+` or `-` fold marker was authored, false for `+` and true for `-`; `title` is a node-valued field of inline content visited before `content` and never counted among its children; a present title holds at least one node; block content

kinds.name: Paragraph
kinds.invariants: inline content

kinds.name: Heading
kinds.invariants: `level` is 1 through 6; inline content

kinds.name: ThematicBreak
kinds.invariants: leaf

kinds.name: List
kinds.invariants: `start` is non-null only for ordered lists

kinds.name: ListItem
kinds.invariants: `marker == null` means not a task item; `exampleLabel` is reserved for example lists; block content

kinds.name: CodeBlock
kinds.invariants: mode is `standalone`; `info` is the complete raw info string; `language` is its first non-whitespace token; indented blocks have `fenced=false, closed=true`

kinds.name: HTMLBlock
kinds.invariants: raw HTML is preserved; a block that opens with `<!--` and whose end line holds only whitespace after the first `-->` is a `Comment`

kinds.name: FormulaBlock
kinds.invariants: mode is `standalone`

kinds.name: Table
kinds.invariants: one alignment per column; header is non-optional

kinds.name: TableRow
kinds.invariants: `isHeader` is true only for `Table.header` and false for entries in `Table.rows`

kinds.name: TableCell
kinds.invariants: inline content

kinds.name: DirectiveBlock
kinds.invariants: attributes preserves first-occurrence source order with unique names; label is a node-valued field whose scope spans its brackets and is never part of content; content is block; an absent attribute container and an empty one remain distinct, as do an absent label and an empty one

kinds.name: DirectiveLabel
kinds.invariants: inline content; the scope spans the brackets, so an empty label is still a place

kinds.name: Text
kinds.invariants: leaf

kinds.name: SoftBreak
kinds.invariants: leaf

kinds.name: LineBreak
kinds.invariants: leaf

kinds.name: Code
kinds.invariants: mode is `embedded`; leaf

kinds.name: HTML
kinds.invariants: raw HTML is preserved; an HTML comment token is a `Comment`; leaf

kinds.name: Comment
kinds.invariants: the one kind valid in both block and inline content, which the parent edge records; `literal` excludes the delimiters and keeps every byte between them; leaf

kinds.name: Formula
kinds.invariants: either mode; leaf

kinds.name: Emphasis
kinds.invariants: inline content

kinds.name: Strong
kinds.invariants: inline content

kinds.name: Strikethrough
kinds.invariants: inline content

kinds.name: Link
kinds.invariants: `dest` is the tagged `Destination` value and is never absent: `[a]()` and `[a](<>)` wrote one and wrote nothing in it, so it is `url("")`; a reference occurrence answers the destination its definition stated, and an unresolved reference is the inherited literal text; every `Link` owns the `url` branch; absent and empty title remain distinct; inline content

kinds.name: Image
kinds.invariants: `dest` is the tagged `Destination` value and is never absent, for the reason `Link.dest` is not; every `Image` owns the `url` branch; absent and empty title remain distinct; content is parsed alt-text inline content

kinds.name: Directive
kinds.invariants: attributes preserves first-occurrence source order with unique names; label is a node-valued field whose scope spans its brackets and is never a child/content element; an absent attribute container and an empty one remain distinct, as do an absent label and an empty one

kinds.name: Cite
kinds.invariants: one or more items in source order; every item has exactly one referent and one cite never mixes referent families; an inherited `[^label]` call is one item with a `footnote` referent whose id is the normalized label without the caret and with empty affixes; its items are scoped values, never children, so it is a leaf

Destination.purpose: A tagged value, not a node: it has no scope, children, anchor, or attributes, and a branch's fields exist only in that branch. Every Link and Image owns the url branch; the cross branch is the workspace address a CrossLink produces once O1 lands.

CitationReferent.purpose: A tagged value, not a node: it has no scope, and a branch's fields exist only in that branch. The bib branch is first produced by the citations module with P7; every inherited footnote call produces the footnote branch, whose id names the Footnote in Document.footnotes with the equal id.

Citation.purpose: One item of a Cite: a scoped value, not a Markup kind, because it is written. It is reached only through Cite.citations, it receives a value callback from the walking visitor, and its affixes are non-null inline content, empty when absent.
Citation.dump: Citation scope=L:C..L:C referent=... children=0, then a CitationPrefix and a CitationSuffix group

Footnote.purpose: One element of Document.footnotes: a scoped value, not a Markup kind, because it is written. Its id is the definition's label under the reference-label normalization without the caret, and its content is the parsed block content of a referenced definition or, once O4 lands, the inline body of an inline footnote.
